parameters.description_en:
The ID of the OTA update package, which serves as its unique identifier.

The OTA update package ID is returned when you call the [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) API to create an OTA update package.

You can also call the [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) API and check the response parameters to obtain this ID.
parameters.description_zh:

OTA升级包ID是调用接口[CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~)创建OTA升级包时，返回的参数之一。

您也可以调用接口[ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~)，从返回参数中查看。

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or **ID** does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.
></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.description_en: The name of the OTA update package, which must be unique within the Alibaba Cloud account. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and half-width parentheses (). It must start with a Chinese character, English letter, Japanese character, or digit, and its length must be 1 to 40 characters.
parameters.description_zh: OTA升级包名称，需在阿里云账号下唯一。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角圆括号（()），必须以中文、英文、日文或数字开头，长度限制为1~40个字符。
